___style_anchor: Handcrafted stop-motion puppet animation — tactile miniature knitwear and tweed tailoring, sculpted matte clay head, wire armature slender limbs, physical stone stairs, and shallow macro photography.

negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, realistic human photograph, CGI 3D digital model, glossy plastic skin, modern clothing, sneakers, nylon backpack, digital rendering artifacts, smiling grin, open mouth
reconstruction_priority: Handcrafted stop-motion puppet materials — AI often replaces real wool knitwear and tweed fabric with generic digital textures
Sculpted matte clay facial profile with hooked nose — AI tends to hallucinate realistic elderly human wrinkles or generic cartoon faces
Slender wire-armature puppet proportions with ribbed knit leggings — AI frequently thickens limbs into realistic human anatomy
Tactile macro depth of field on miniature stone steps — AI often fails to render physical miniature scale and optical lens blur
